about_the_game:
SURVIVE OR DIE TRYIN!!

Welcome to downtown Catsburg: where the streets bleed neon and the critters bite back. Your city has been over-run by rabid gangs of blood thirsty critters hellbent on causing mayhem & destruction. You play as private detective Mitch Birman, an ex-Vietnam vet, with a trunk full of guns and a personal vendetta against the little punks that plague your city.

A brutally chaotic top-down survival shooter from EMMY winning duo StudioNX, creators of the arcade smash The Videokid & writers on the BAFTA winning game Endling, Extinction is forever.


WISHLIST NOW to get notified when the chaos drops!

GAMEPLAY

Fight to survive in this single player roguelite arcade shooter where every second counts. Dodge, blast & scavenge your way through procedurally generated chaos as you battle the Gorecat hordes. Each run is different. Each death is permanent. Each comeback is legendary

CONTROLS

Supports controller, mouse & keyboard.

FEATURES

  • Lightning-fast, survival combat - melee, stun & outgun waves of feral Gorecats!

  • Collect ammo, medi-kits & coins to upgrade your arsenal & stay alive!

  • Wield iconic weapons from Mitch's 'Nam days like the M16 & bone rattling M60!

  • Dive into a Neo-Noir pixel art nightmare by legendary artist/animator Wacko!

  • Headbanging heavy-metal chiptune soundtrack by Pavle!


Think you’ve got what it takes to clean up Catsburg? Lock & load, the Gorecats are waiting...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
